title: PyVWF: An open Python framework for bias-corrected wind power simulation from reanalysis data
description: An open, research-oriented Python framework that converts atmospheric reanalysis data (e.g. ERA5) into bias-corrected wind power generation. PyVWF re-implements the Virtual Wind Farm (VWF) methodology used by Renewables.ninja, exposing the full training workflow for observation-based bias-correction factors at turbine, regional, or national scale, with configurable spatial clustering and temporal aggregation.
